run_note: A new run (new run_id and requested_modules change PreparedPack.content_hash), over the S1 source bytes. It is the CP-2D run plus CP-3C: pathway covenant_refinancing (FP04, render.py:130; contracts.py lists CP-3C in that pathway). CP-MODEL is left out (registry.plan would put it before CP-2D and G1 refuses an analytical module after a deterministic one). No legal source: CP-4 is an optional, unread edge in this version (see optional_edges).

edges.source: src/deploy_vii/methodology.json (pinned) and registry.edge_rule (probed 2026-10-28); no edge_rules entry for CP-3C

unread.CP-4: LME capacity needs CP-4's basket capacity amounts, which the frozen CP-4 oracle always shows as missing ('Basket capacity amounts are not calculated'), and CP-4 runs on the legal pack (a different pack and promotion). Nothing computable would flow in; the LME half is shown as honest gaps (T3D.5) and the liability-management path is Insufficient Information
unread.CP-3D: Market-implied spread and default intensity need the CP-3D market source (third_party) in the pack and the pack has no reference rate level; refinancing cost is shown as a margin step-up over current terms instead
unread.CP-2A: A stressed refinancing case needs a CP-2A run; the Stress column of T3D.5 is a gap
unread.CP-1A: Business and ownership context would inform owner-support and asset-sale paths; not read, the path is Insufficient Information

optional_edges.rule: An unread optional edge is absent from attempt.inputs, from the view and from the trace; each unread edge is an own limitation

run_note_cp1_downstream: CP-1's downstream-readiness stage names CP-3C requirements debt_schedule and maturity_profile (downstream_readiness.py:34, :178). The S1 readiness literal assesses no consumer (consumers: []), so on the S1 route CP-1 T4.13 shows every consumer not_ready and nothing supplies them; this run therefore ships its own CP-1 readiness literal (submissions.json#cp1_downstream_review) that assesses CP-2D and CP-3C, and expected.json#cp1_downstream_readiness pins the outcome (CP-3C and CP-2D ready_with_limitations). The CP-2D frozen run is unchanged. T4.13 does not gate begin (the edge rule does).

fact_copy_rule: A table cell copied from a CP-1 or CP-2D fact keeps that fact's own value_class and citations or calculation_id (CP-1 T4.18 source; CP-2D principal and maturity source, months and inside-horizon calculated, CP-2D horizon and minimum cash analyst_judgment); amounts are in unit MILLIONS with currency USD on every MILLIONS cell, a missing or not-applicable cell carrying its settled twin's unit and currency (CP-1 T4.10 facts already are; the CP-2D cells already are; CP-2D lease acceptance 1 pins currency USD on every amount cell; the CP-1C rule extends it to gap cells). Copies carry cp1_operand or cp2d_operand in expected.json. For a cp2d_operand copy the amount, unit, state and shown value equal the frozen CP-2D oracle cell; its period and value_class are the CP-2D head fact's own, bound at run time: the period 2025-12-31 and, for a copied gap, the value_class written here are this oracle's proposal, which the CP-2D oracle does not pin (it records neither). A copy of an analyst_judgment fact is never referenced by a claim.
ratio_storage_rule: Ratio facts (multiples, shares, cover) are stored quantised to 4 dp half-up; the shown value rounds from the stored one (display.py ROUND_HALF_UP); amounts are exact Decimals.
